title: Bible Doubters IQ: Who Really Said It?
subtitle: Even the heroes of faith had their wobbly moments. How well do you know the Bible's famous doubters?

questions.text: Which disciple said he wouldn't believe Jesus had risen until he touched the nail marks himself?

options.explanation: In John 20:25, Thomas said, "Unless I see the nail marks in his hands... I will not believe." It earned him the nickname Doubting Thomas.

questions.text: Who laughed when she overheard that she would have a son in her old age?

options.explanation: Genesis 18:12 says Sarah laughed to herself, thinking she was far too old. God gently asked, "Is anything too hard for the Lord?"

questions.text: Who asked God for a sign with a wool fleece, not once but twice, before going to battle?

options.explanation: In Judges 6, Gideon laid out a fleece and asked God to make it wet while the ground stayed dry, then reversed the test the next night to be sure.

questions.text: Who sent messengers from prison to ask Jesus, "Are you the one who is to come, or should we expect someone else?"

options.explanation: Matthew 11:2-3 records John the Baptist, sitting in prison, sending this honest question to Jesus through his disciples.

questions.text: Who cried out to Jesus, "I do believe; help me overcome my unbelief!"?

options.text: The father of a demon-possessed boy
options.explanation: In Mark 9:24, the father of a suffering boy gave this raw, honest prayer, and Jesus healed his son anyway.

questions.text: Zechariah doubted the angel's news that he would have a son. What happened to him as a result?

options.text: He was unable to speak until the baby was born
options.explanation: In Luke 1:20, the angel Gabriel told Zechariah he would be silent and unable to speak until John was born, because he did not believe.

options.text: He had to leave the temple

questions.text: When Peter walked on the water toward Jesus, why did he begin to sink?

options.text: He saw the wind and was afraid
options.explanation: Matthew 14:30 says when Peter saw the wind, he was afraid and began to sink. Jesus caught him and said, "You of little faith, why did you doubt?"

options.text: The other disciples called him back

questions.text: Which prophet ran away and wanted to die after a huge victory, sure he was the only faithful one left?

options.explanation: In 1 Kings 19, Elijah fled from Jezebel, sat under a broom tree, and asked to die. God answered with food, rest, and a gentle whisper.

questions.text: What did Jesus offer to show Thomas to settle his doubt?

options.explanation: In John 20:27, Jesus told Thomas to put his finger where the nails had been and reach into his side. He met the doubt instead of shaming it.

questions.text: Who sat under a vine and a withered plant, angry and discouraged, after God spared a city he didn't want spared?

options.explanation: In Jonah 4, Jonah sulked under a plant, angry that God showed mercy to Nineveh. God used the withered plant to teach him about compassion.

questions.text: How did Jesus respond to Thomas after the doubting disciple finally believed?

options.text: He blessed those who believe without seeing
options.explanation: In John 20:29, Jesus said, "Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."

questions.text: Abraham believed God's promise of a son, but what did he and Sarah do that showed their doubt about the timing?

options.text: They moved to a new land
They had a child through Hagar
options.explanation: In Genesis 16, Sarah, doubting she would conceive, gave her servant Hagar to Abraham, and Ishmael was born before the promised son Isaac arrived.

options.text: They asked for a sign in the sky

scoring.perfectMessage: Flawless. You know the Bible's doubters inside and out, and you know the grace that met every one of them.

gradeBands.label: Skeptic
gradeBands.message: A solid start. These doubters are worth getting to know. Every one of them wrestled, and God met them right in it.

gradeBands.label: Seeker
gradeBands.message: Nicely done. You know these stories well, and you can see how doubt and faith often live side by side.

gradeBands.label: Scholar
gradeBands.message: Impressive. You really know the Bible's honest wrestlers and the patient God who answered them.

gradeBands.label: Scholar
gradeBands.message: Flawless. You know the Bible's doubters inside and out, and you know the grace that met every one of them.
